node.title: Mersenne common-factor mass router
node.closure: an unsafe interpolation factor captures almost all inside received coordinates
node.statement: At Mersenne full-lift support e=130237, let P be the primitive full common factor of the weight-264 interpolation kernel and let d be its positive Y,Z degree. The capped bank forces 7583 distinct line pairs. After dividing by P, affine Bezout permits at most (52-d)^2 pairs off P, so at least 7583-(52-d)^2 lie on P. Uniformly in 1<=d<=52 this is at least 4982 pairs. Their inside cores have size at least 807 and pairwise intersections at most 5, forcing P(x,r0(x),r1(x))=0 on at least 126188 of the 130237 inside coordinates. Thus the residual common factor has at most 4049 exceptional inside coordinates.
